
# Background

This blog is for my research notes, and personal thoughts. It also has a review section for reviewing books, and papers. I also cover meetups and conferences I attend but this is not the main focus.

# Tech stack:

- Quarto
- GitHub Pages
- GitHub Actions
- Latex
- Mermaid
- R & Python

# Coding & Formatting Rules
- **Formatting:** Use Quarto Markdown (`.qmd`) files.
- **YAML Headers:** Always ensure proper YAML metadata (title, author, date, categories) in new posts.
- **Code Chunks:** Use standard knitr (R) or Jupyter (Python) syntax. Always add descriptive `#| label` and `#| fig-cap` in chunk options.
- **Data & Tables:** Prefer `knitr::kable()` for formatting R dataframes.
- **Layout:** Use Quarto divs (`:::`) for callouts, panels, and layout customization.
- **Accessibility:** Ensure images have alt text.

## Your main goal 

- Make blogging fun and easy for me, so I can focus on the content and not on the technical details of maintaining a blog.
- Help keep things consistent across posts, so that the blog has a cohesive look and feel.
- Help fix typos and grammatical errors. I'd prefer higher level of english so chime in when you think something can be improved.
